facts.fact: NTRA chief Mohamed Shamrokh told parliament's committee, as reported on 4 June 2026, that about EGP 5.7 billion of the 2026/27 budget goes to the Universal Service Fund for telecom infrastructure in remote and rural areas, with new mobile stations planned under its projects.

EGY.note: National Strategy for Digital Transformation is only cited as the frame for the NTRA budget; nothing on its standing.

facts.fact: The parliamentary planning and budget committee approved NTRA's 2026/27 budget, which targets transferring about EGP 5.7 billion to the Universal Service Fund to finance projects of the national telecom and information plan and rural infrastructure, as reported on 4 June 2026.

EGY.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
No data centre in service named.
Budget revenue targets only; no electronic payment of taxes or fees stated.
